name: How do I get an accurate exterior remodeling quote?

mainEntity.name: What information do I need to give a contractor to get an accurate exterior remodeling estimate?
mainEntity.text: What information do I need to give a contractor to get an accurate exterior remodeling estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accurate exterior remodel quote starts with clear project information. Contractors need photos, approximate measurements, the property address, and a specific description of what should be replaced, repaired, or added. It helps to identify current materials, problem areas, and any goals related to curb appeal, energy performance, maintenance, or resale. If the project includes windows, doors, stucco, siding, roofing, patio covers, lighting, or hardscape, list each item separately so the contractor can price them correctly. Also note access constraints such as narrow side yards, limited parking, steep slopes, or occupied living spaces. The more precise the scope, the less likely the estimate will miss major items. Homeowners should also ask whether the quote includes permits, demolition, disposal, waterproofing, patching, and finish repair. If a bid is based on vague assumptions, it will be less reliable. A good quote reflects the actual construction path, not just the visible finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide photos, measurements, address, desired finishes, project goals, and a clear list of what stays and what gets replaced. Include details about windows, doors, siding, stucco, roofing, hardscape, drainage, and access limitations. Accurate quotes come from specific scope documents, not a brief description of the job.
